notes.title: Survivors of the Dawn is 1 Year Old! 🎉🎂🥳
notes.content:
Howdy partner! 🤠

This time we’re back for a BIG appreciation post for every single one of you who’s been with us since day one and for the support and interest you have shown throughout our first year of Early Access. 

What started as a solo-dev journey has become a huge community of thousands of survivors. Thank you for believing in us and helping shape Survivors of the Dawn!

Here’s to the road into 1.0 Release ahead! 🎉

Year in Review
We’ve had dozens of Playtests and been experimenting all kinds of features with you all and here’s what we have added into the game throughout the year so far:

 6 Playable Characters
 3 Different Maps
 4 Soundtracks
 20+ Weapons
 30+ Items
 10+ Types of Terminals
 14 Meta Upgrades
 80+ Achievements
 Armory and Upgrade Rarity Systems
 Controller Support
 Steam Cloud Save
 Localization in 12 languages (HUGE thanks to our community for their help!🧡)
And TONS more Features of varying sizes, Balances and Fixes we weren’t able to include here…

What to expect now?
As mentioned before, a NEW GAME MODE of challenges is promised to arrive soon. Can you already guess what kind?

Updated Early Access Answers
As the game progressed, a lot changed since day one, just like all the decisions made and actions taken. So we have also updated our answers on the Early Access section. Make sure to check them out! 

New Trailer
A fresh new trailer that has everything in the game is also out now on our Steam page!

Quick News!
Survivors of the Dawn is a part of the 🌙Land of the Crescent Games from Türkiye 2024 this year! Check out all the fantastic games each better than the other!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546614/6c5eed0a2c7824a1b98e07ecc8855b95114ba834.png

Wish you a gut-wrenching run! 🐸🦀🌀

‘till next time,
your friends at indieGiant

notes.title: Save 50% OFF on Daily Deal!
notes.content:
🥳🎉BIG NEWS! 🥳🎉

Hope you got the new major update notifs everyone! To celebrate the New Rarity, Upgrade & Armory Systems Update, we are 50% OFF on Today’s Deal! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2285630/Survivors_of_the_Dawn/

We hear all your feedback and keep updating the game. Thank you each and everyone of you for your valuable feedback. 

PRO TIPS
Here are some tips and tricks for first-timers and beginner players for an easier start in the game:
Your only goal in the game is not just wiping out the hordes but also bag Items and Weapon Modifiers

Find and complete as many terminals and tasks around as possible.
Spend the credits you earn on Items and Armory..
Don't forget to wipe out the hordes and collect as many XPs as possible.
Evolve stronger and become THE ULTIMATE bullet. 
Repeat. 
The more Items and Weapon Modifiers you collect, the higher your chance is to survive! 

We realized that the game is way too cruel for the beginner players. Along with the recent modularization of the Rarity and Weapon Upgrade systems,  the initial and upgrade rates of the weapons were lagging behind the game's pace.

Following that, adjustments and balancing have been made to the weapons. So here's what we've changed according to your responses:

CHANGES

Balance on difficulty to make it easier for first-time beginner players whereas harder for the veteran players. 
Balance on Weapon Modifier prices. Specifically in the advancing levels of the game, prices would get too expensive, as we want the Weapon Modifiers to be used more in the game, it was fixed.
Balance on Side objectives. Some objectives seemed way too difficult to complete, the steps have been decreased. 
Balance on Meta Upgrades, cooldown boost rate of Rewind upgrade increased to 5%.
Meta Upgrades prices decreased; increasing-price multiplier decreased according to the level. 
Bounty Chest model size scaled up.
Bounty Chest model color changed to blue.
Balance on the incoming enemy amount on Inferno Easy level. Specifically for the beginner players, Inferno Easy difficulty level would get too challenging, a game design aimed to make it more first-timer friendly is here. 
Enemy attack damage on Inferno Easy level decreased. 
Balance on enemy HP on Inferno Easy Level.
Uncommon and Rare Weapon Upgrades drop possibility increased. 
Weapons firing multiple times after getting the Rewind Upgrade issue fixed. 
Weapon Modifiers price multiplier decreased. 
Missiles hitting the environment obstacles caused by Typhoon R44 bug fixed.
Reduced the negative effect ratios of some Weapon Modifiers. Just as in the earlier versions of the game, we want the Weapon Modifiers to stay in a place that supports the players, and we realized it was way too punishing for the players. So, we weakened the negative effects. 
Increased the spawn frequency of Crystals.
Fixed spelling errors in Upgrade and Weapon Modifier descriptions.
Additions to the Turkish localization.

notes.title: New Rarity, Upgrade & Armory Systems
notes.content:
Hey there guys and gals!!

We are back again with another Major Update full of ENDLESS POSSIBILITIES! 

THE UPDATE IS UPDATIN

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546614/a19448f1afdd1187f326e42aa79d3cc9e5cea1b4.gif

Armory System
Contrary to the pre-existing linear system, changes have been made to plan a defense mechanism with a variety of up to 40 Weapon Modifiers to balance their strengths with subtle or not-so-subtle drawbacks.

Rarity and New Upgrade System
Rarity system in the Weapon Upgrades is here with endless possibilites! Besides, the newly rennovated Upgrade System now enables you get the same upgrades in different ways PLUS multiple times. Whatever Rarity drops to your chance, your Weapons can be upgraded into that, along with changing the Weapon Stats based on its Rarity. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546614/ac19461033533561a60e1475ca6003a3e5988c9e.gif

Updated Models
The ones who might have been struggling to which terminal to swing by not sure of what they give or take, this one’s for you! We’ve remodeled the terminals to help you get the gist of what it leads to easier. What else? XPs, Credits, Boosters, Bounty Chests and much more look more fresh than ever...

Character Selection Screen
Decision-making made easy! Now, you can get a grasp of who you’re gonna fight as in an easier way to be sent right into the throes of combat through the depths of outer space. 

You’ve now only scratched the surface. There’s a lot more hidden beneath this new update, with numerous more still to be revealed as you play a run or two. Get ready to surpass the tip of the iceberg!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546614/baaa575f54dcbf8cab60ac511323272986df355a.gif

Coming Up Next
Since Day 1 we have released a whole lot of updates with content, systems, remodels, UI/UX improvements etc. throughout the Early Access. NOW a New Game Mode is next in line and packed with new content to challenge all you have! 


Wish you a gut-wrenching run! 🐸 🦀 🌀
‘till next time,
your friends at indieGiant

notes.title: Major Update ⚙️ Playtest ⚙️ - We Need Your Help!
notes.content:
Hello there Guys and Gals!!

The next Major Update is almost here and coming in the end of August! However, this time it brings along some drastic changes in the core mechanics of the game.

Beta Playtest

While we are gettng everything perfectly ready for you, we’ve got a little favor to ask. We have a ready-to-play Playtest, and we would love to hear the opinion of each and everyone of you and find out if there are any issues we can avoid before we let the rest of the world play it. 

How to Switch to the Beta Playtest?

1. Select the game in your library. Then click on the ⚙️gear icon, then click Properties.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546614/ff8a1fc496d64fd30935c8b21d1a0e6bb9ae0b2d.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546614/2437b1ced9323c3728165e8c3dc94c8c79054731.png

You can always go back to the original game by doing the same and selecting the None branch which will bring you back to the previous version's normal Early Access game mode.

notes.title: New Survivors, Terminals & Objectives, Weapons & Items
notes.content:
Howdy Partner! 

The fresh new Content Update is OUT NOW! Please welcome the Newbies: 🪖Kandahar & 🐸Lotus!

The unfathomable chaos brews as quintillions upon quintillions of grotesque hordes continue to rise from the abyss, the renovated rigorous training regimen is designed to ensure each of the Newbies is prepared for the merciless front line where there is no pause, no respite…

Since the last time you heard from us which was a Maaajor Content Update, we wanted to invite you over to delve deeper into seeing what’s cooking and we wanted to find another excuse to offer some fresh new additions from Survivors of the Dawn, which will be ready to play in about… NOW!

Then and Beyond
We’ve transitioned from broad content updates to focusing on game mechanics and systems. As Survivors of the Dawn is being made based on Endless Replayability: the feeling of playing a whole another game in each run, now these updates are in progress which will highlight the game’s unique features.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546614/8d1090e711c4c2e57700900280a99f6338d80214.gif

New Drip: Characters, Items, and More!
In the meantime, the game's existing system undergoes evolution, enhancing the way you mix and match your items to your weapons, exploring rewarding terminals, and upgrading your character with power-ups behind the scenes. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546614/f064790123d199ff137a681394758b7f0835b7ef.gif

Without further ado, let us convince you why you should taste this new mouthful of an update: 

2 New Survivors
🪖Kandahar: Once a lone mountain combatant, now a survivor full of hatred who lost all his team in a treacherous ambush, only hungry for blood
🐸Lotus: A former mutated scientist, offers his expertise in bio-engineering to build synergies.

10 Different Items
Dashes are smooooth operators now, you are free to loot your way out by boosted drops. The duty awaits, DESTROY comfortably under the blessed protection of both large and small 2 new shields, and finally we’re RICH with generous Factory-es FYI.

2 New Tracks
Cause the extinction of the ugly alien races to sick beats.
2 more on the way… (Coming Soon!) 

4  Additional Terminal Tasks
You are invited to not only test your mettle amidst chaos but also earn yourself some extra Credits, skills, XPs or even HP regen. Max your HP on the Spider Bot, let the S.O.S terminal run to the rescue, and taste the defeat on Sacrifice terminals; because you know, no pain no gain. 

2 New Weapons
Synergies? Synergies.  Harvest your bullet domination and yeah, the knives are out so, equip your Split Blades. 

Various Map Objectives
Map out your route, each step in all destinations brings you closer to domination, don’t leave your earned Bounty Bits behind afterwards. More detailed info on Result screens, you can now see how many Bounty Bits earned, and what effects these in a more elaborate way.

2 New Meta Upgrades (HP regen is here!)
You know what they say “Victory is not always about winning the battle but rising every time you fall.

A New Armor Upgrade
Snatch when you see them on the level-up screen, cause it lowers the flat damage by those ugly creatures.

Language Improvements:

Localization (Chinese, English & Turkish)
Typo fixes (more than additions…)
Community-Driven Updates:

2 New Tracks (2 more on the way… Coming Soon!)
Controller improvements
New Characters (It was your call… New Survivors are about to join!)
More Defensive items and upgrades.

Please mix and match reasonably. 

Patch Notes:

🎮 [FEATURE]  In some runs, the Bounty Chest open amount can reach up to more than 50, and the Bounty Chest drop rate has been increased. Items drop randomly, The Selection screen is removed now. It was an improvement to fasten the game flow, to prevent the gameplay from getting cut off so often. 
🎮 [FEATURE]  New Map Objectives, earn Bounty Bits when completed. 
🎮 [FEATURE]  The number of items and upgrades with defensive qualities have been increased: 2 new Meta Upgrades, 1 Upgrade, and 3 Defensive Items. 
🎮 [FEATURE]  New achievements have been added while the ones that required too much grind and the ones that are related to features not available in the game anymore have been removed. 
🎮 [FEATURE]  New explosive enemies with wider damage areas.
⚡️[QOL] Map camera speed on Mac increased.
⚡️[QOL] Localization Improvements.

notes.title: MAJOR CONTENT UPDATE BLEUMER🪼- OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Howdy partner! 🪼 🐊 🦀

Major Content Update🪼BLEUMER🪼 is LIVE NOW!

WILL YOU DESCEND INTO THE ABYSSAL REALM?
It’s the biggest content update yet, so without further ado here’s what the full package offers:

Where we at?

We are descending into the abyssal realm, right under the surface. The latest addition is the BLEUMER Map🪼  which brings its own challenges and fun. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546614/556f8813932be6b99247d01c9f0c59d3f0b3d69d.gif

Who's the new face?

A New Character and its slick New Weapon with perks on its own is here to wipe the new undersea challenges off the new realm.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546614/ef9acfa0bde2c6abcf6cd694d8c1a9582373f96d.gif

Who are these undersea challenges in question?

Nothing other than 16 New Enemies and 2 Bosses of course.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546614/104ba7279c059ec5277c703930f3df81bac16caa.gif

The Enemies just inflate to explode around you, some throw stuff or some even jump at you, some actually tail-slap you.

On the other side, Bosses try to take you down quite literally by clenching or raining fire over you. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546614/72f892a31de8fe581bed32292187b5506398d879.gif

How to beat them?

Easy as pie. Just include any of the 5 New Weapons in your builds, or just mix and match all 5 of them together or whatever, it’s the way you want it!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546614/c83dc7a5c26f037f455ce0eaa37dcc9ac0d8b3c2.gif


Patch Notes

Of course it’s not all that’s new, let’s get rolling for a deep dive into what has changed in the game so far:

⚡️[QoL] Damage pop-ups font changed.
⚡️[QoL] Floor End, Survived, Game Over unable to pause now.

⚡️[QoL] Optimization on level loads.

⚡️[QoL] Camera zoomed into the character.

🚀 [Feature] Item and weapon unlock notifications added.
🚀 [Feature] Database added, in which the weapons and items are controlled.

🚀 [Feature] Unlock System for weapons, items and upgrades will be unlocked through progression.

notes.title: V0.3.6 New Weapons & Controller Support?
notes.content:
Howdy Partner!

Long time no see! 
However, we are back with an update fresher than ever, and it’s full of new weapons and stuff.

New weapons!  
Most of the feedback we got from you revolved around variety of weapons so we are back with new auto-weapons, each having their own unique attributes. We're really excited to let you try it out now!  
Do let us know what you think! 

5 new auto-weapons has been added:

 Typhoon R44: Missiles thrown at the faced direction.  
 Blight: Generates a toxic gas area when dropped.
 Flamemaw: A turret throwing constant flames.
 Tesla Beam: Beams of electrical damage to immediately freeze the enemies.
 Saberlight: Pink laser sabers thrown at faced direction.

 Better controller support  is here! Another popular demand also wasn't left unanswered...
It is available on almost everything in the game including majority of the menu, the rest of the in-game support is coming really soon! Stick around!

FMOD integration!  
We got lots of feedback that the sound would overlap in a little too annoying way. In order to fix that we adopted FMOD into the game.
It sounds way better and well-settled compared to the previous one! Hear it for yourself, we promise it's worth the try! 

HP regeneration? 
Remember the times when you regenerated HP whenever you travelled to the next floor? It's gone now. Some voices came to our ears that the HP regeneration made the game wayy to easy so, we decided to take it back which accelerates the roguelike-ification of the game. We did some balance though, you'll still be able to survive partner! 

10 More Random Events! Balanced for more reward benefits. 

Optimization polishes nonstop on-the-go, for the ever-improving gameplay experience. Movemement logic has been optimied to make place for many more hordes.

notes.title: Devlog #1
notes.content:
End of Post-Release Week 1  & Our Plans?

Howdy Partner!

Today marks exactly 1 week after the release!!  

After 1 year of solo-development and all the ups and downs it feels unreal to show it to all of you and see how much fun you are having in the game. 

It's been hell of a week, but once more we can't thank you enough for all the support and love you have showed for Survivors of the Dawn! 

We have heard all the feedback you have sent us over Discussions and Discord so here's:

What to Expect in the Near Future:

 Weapon variety in progress. (5 new weapons already under development)
 Variety of content (Floor Objectives, Terminal Tasks, Items, Shops, and Characters etc. wise)  
 Full controller support is coming sooner than you expect so keep an eye on that.
 More detailed UI, pause screens; items, passive-active upgrades, synergy classes to be more available. 
 The sounds may become messy through the later stages in the game so, it is prioritized to be polished.

Here's what we plan to accomplish until the full release (May subject to expand even more)
The Overall Roadmap:

 8/30 Auto Weapons Weapon variety is one of the top priorities so expect a handful of them in the upcoming updates. 
 3/10 Characters: The crew is planned to grow so we are keeping an eye out for new members.
 20/30 Item Variations
 2/4 Maps
 4/10 Terminal Tasks 
 10/50 Various Random Events: They are planned to be give you more control of the in-game balance along with the connection of the story.
 New Meta Progression Elements: You must learn how to spend your Bounty Bits more reasonably sooner or later.
 New floor objectives
 Optimization: It is the key component of our game so we plan to serve you the best experience possible. 
 Enemy and Boss Variety: New enemy and boss behaviors are planned so that you don't die out of boredom instead of them.
 UI improvements
 SFX balance and improvement reworks

Along the way through 1.0, we plan to balance the game. We would like to improve the game with the community to the best potential so, pease join us in our journey and  don't hesitate drop any feedback or suggestions you have with us. 

Plus, don't hesitate to let us know in the comment below if you'd like any of them to be prioritized.

What's been fixed meanwhile:

 Diffculty balance
 Achievement balances
 Optimization (projectiles, horde movements)
 Map is limited after time limit is done on Boss floors.
 Droids empowered
 Stats not changed on the upgrade screen
 Timer hits "60" seconds on the UI
 Grisly Fee Achivement issue

Known Bugs:

 MacOS system achievements issue on MacOS

Localization Updates:

 Spanish (Spain) updated. (Special thanks to Alberto Gómez Herrera (Estyx Translations) 
 Chinese translation improved.
 Russian translation improvements in progress.



Huge thanks & cheers!
indieGiant Games 🤘🏻

notes.title: DEMO LIVE NOW!
notes.content:
Howdy bounty hunters! 

We’re once again back to invite you to our next Playtest with a public demo! 
Head to our Steam page and join us once more in the fun developing Survivors of the Dawn! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546614/dee06cb064c7305ccc7c889ddeaa1d74953e7ddb.gif

 Beta V.0.3.4 Development Updates and Patch Notes 

Thank you all for the great feedback and support in the last playtest, we have been able to improve the game all thanks to your participation!
Now it’s time to crawl back once more to the brain-numbing nature of Survivors of the Dawn!

New Characters:
Now you have more than one single default weapon choice that is character-exclusive with the Auto-Aim option. All characters have their own unique stats all at your service to choose from before each run. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546614/455b0db868508197fb5a1597a2610947c0f8bb54.gif

Main Game Mode:
The original main game mode has returned! Now you are able to travel through the whole interstellar.

Item Variations:
New items alert! We were aiming for them to have a  crucial role in building the gameplay loop just so that you can build diversified and even stronger weapon item combos each time. You may have the option to freeze the enemies or many more if you are lucky enough! 
- Items are stackable now.

Tasks: 
Tasks have been diversified to make the game more dynamic and action-packed. Complete the tasks to get stronger sooner.
4 types of tasks available now: 
- Kill within the circle.
- Kill in or out of the circle.
- Stay in the area long enough to open the bounty chest capsule.
- Destroy the hives.

New Passive Weapons:
Remember the passive weapons that seemed abstract but you felt under your skin? 
They are right at your face now with features like:
- XP income increase
- Credit income increase
- Pickup range increase

Map Destinations:
You can dive right into combat now. You used to arrive at random events and the shops on the map; however now, they are right in the middle of combat and all you need to do is break through hordes to get to them.
- In the shops, you’ll be able to have more customization control over your run with the purchasable items and character-exclusive weapon upgrades.
- Each choice matters! In each random event, there is an element that holds great importance and you are all on your own to set the difficulty of your next combat now! 
-It also comes with a bonus Treasure map on the drive to enrich you onto your next destination.

Procedurally Generated Maps:
All roads lead to Rome? More like no road limit to the terrains, you are free to roam wherever you want, unless hordes try to corner you, oh wait, they can’t! They can only surround you until you exterminate them.

New Main Menu: 
Let’s jump right in with the new immersive menu screen design to the seamless transition into options screen. 
Oh, and the meta progression upgrades are removed until further notice! 

Bosses:
New elite bosses are here to ruin and just so you can understand who you are dealing with, plus to not be too overwhelmed when fighting with them, now you can see the HP of the boss during combat. 

Enemies: 
New races of enemies have landed, and they even have hives now to never cease bubbling right into your face. Plus, proudly serving the nitty gritty optimization in hordes.

UI Improvements:
We are not an expert at UI/UX, however it is one of our priorities on our route to the best player experience possible, so in the light of that we improved the pause screen when you level up, added more distinct stats and played with the XP bar position. Lastly for the record, we added the weapon reload, you’ll feel you’re in the combat scene on your own now.
A few more notable changes:
- AR removed
- Number keys on weapon upgrades

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546614/00f8f1f30ea5259741c6428435558e24bc1ae240.gif

Quality of Life Updates:
Visual improvements such as vfx and animations can be felt tangibly and trust us it adds to the gameplay feels more now. 
- Camera angle have been tweaked.

Audio Improvements:
Music and sfx has been improved to prevent the jarring gameplay and we are hard at work for producing many more to come! 

Gamepad Support:
Last but not least, though there is still tons of work to do for the full experience, the partial in-game controller support is available to try out now!

JOIN US IN OUR DEVELOPMENT JOURNEY
Thank you for tagging along in our journey. We’re super excited to hear what your take on the new features and additions will be, and we’re all ears for your suggestions. You’re invited to our Discord server to help us improve the game to the best experience possible, or even to leave any comments you have.  

Stay safe until the next one! 

Stay up-to-date and in touch with us on Discord and Twitter.

Cheers,
indieGiant Games 🤟

notes.title: Patch Notes - V0.3.25
notes.content:
We have been keeping up with all your feedback, we appreciate all of them.  Thank you for reporting.

Fixed

- The direction problem of the bullets fired off the droids' weapons.
- After the player starts the level, landing multiple times bug.
